title: Gameplay From My WIP Game - Black Hollow!
author: Zamaxan1
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1uoeu1g/video/m61mztazghbh1/player

  
I would love some input on this gameplay. I used Codex to help implement the rag dolling effects as well as fine-tuning certain projectile scripts and impact effects. It has been super helpful in troubleshooting errors and helping me track down error lines of code.

  
Feel free to try yourself. - Demo on [Itch.io](http://Itch.io)

comments.author: BoltVnderhuge
comments.body:
The upgrade screen is jarring ugly compared to the rest of the game!

Is it only a single enemy type?

replies.author: Zamaxan1
replies.body:
It’s just now a playable project, hence the demo and no purchase yet. 

The upgrade screen is a WIP - it will be updated

There is a single enemy type right now in the playable build. Again, as it is a demo/very early build.

3 more enemy types are designed and in my project. Their attack patterns/UI are not fully implemented yet, so they are not in the current build.

This project is only like a month into development and it is my first ever game.

Hard to tell tone over messages but ya come off kinda strong lol

comments.author: Kingnorik
comments.body: How are y'all paying for steam pages so early in development. It's like $100.

replies.author: Zamaxan1
replies.body: Well, bluntly, I work full time at a decently paying job. I was able to just pay for it. I’m 29 🤣

replies.author: Kingnorik
replies.body: Fair, it's just high for me and itch is free until you get enough interest.

replies.author: Zamaxan1
replies.body:
That’s true. I’m using both in tandem.

I’m using itch as the demo/playtest for now that I can upload and test builds on. The steam page has traffic being routed to it. I’m at 25 wishlists and just got my page fully open on 7/3. Hoping I can maintain and get \~50 ish each week for the next few weeks and maybe it’ll start picking up more
